title: Fault injection event
description: One start or stop of a fault injection instance, published on gt/{unit_id}/injection. It is the ground truth of what the machine data contains; no message under the plant root ever carries it.

event.description: Whether the instance begins or ends with this message.

params.description: The parameters resolved for this instance, after defaults and bounds were applied.

ends_sim_ts.description: When the instance expires; on a stop message, when it was going to expire.

reason.description: Why the instance ended; present on stop messages only.

instance_params.title: Resolved instance parameters
instance_params.description: The two parameters an injection instance runs with.
